analyzed_vuln.description: In `get_vlmeta_from_trailer`, bounds checking for variable-length metalayer content uses signed 32-bit arithmetic: `if (trailer_len < offset + 1 + 4 + content_len)`. With attacker-controlled trailer fields, `offset + 5 + content_len` can overflow `int32_t` to a negative value, bypassing the check. The code then calls `memcpy(content, content_marker + 5, (size_t)content_len)`, where `content_len` is promoted to a huge unsigned size (seen as 2147483647), causing ASan `negative-size-param` in memcpy.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: The fuzzer passes arbitrary bytes to `blosc2_schunk_from_buffer` (harness `decompress_frame_fuzzer`), which parses an in-memory frame via `frame_to_schunk -> frame_get_vlmetalayers -> get_vlmeta_from_trailer`. A crafted trailer must set vlmeta index/content fields so `content_len` is non-negative but large enough (with chosen `offset`) to trigger signed overflow in the size check expression, letting execution reach the final `memcpy` with an invalid huge length.
